title: RPG Attack Alyve Edition
description: Ever wanted to experience a Vanilla+ Modpack that is based on Craftattack the german series? This is it. A true unique sorted collection of nice mods to have a own project with friends!
body:
This modpack delivers a fully enhanced survival experience built for multiplayer gameplay. Explore vast worlds, conquer challenging environments, battle new hostile creatures, and build thriving bases together. Designed for performance and stability, it supports large groups and community servers, offering endless progression and adventure possibilities.

Features

Advanced survival mechanics with increased difficulty and strategic combat

Expanded world generation with new biomes, structures, dungeons, and secrets

Optimized for multiplayer servers and large player groups

New crafting systems, progression paths, gear upgrades, and resource mechanics

Open-ended gameplay focused on exploration, building, teamwork, and long-term survival

Goal of the Modpack
To provide an immersive and challenging adventure survival experience where players must cooperate, adapt, and explore a rich and evolving world without limits.
